title: Plancherel identity on the binary cube
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f,g:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$. The uniform average of $f(x)g(x)$ over $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$ equals $\sum_{\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n}\widehat f(\gamma)\widehat g(\gamma)$, where each Fourier coefficient is the uniform average of the function times the Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$.
